verdict.rationale: Logseq exposes a plugin API with documentation hosted at plugins-doc.logseq.com, though it is described as community-driven. It supports a Marketplace of third-party plugins and a 'Load unpacked plugin' path for loading locally developed plugins, so developers can clearly build their own. Missing for 10: evidence of sample/example plugins or starter templates, first-party (non-community) SDK docs, and independent hands-on reports of building plugins.
